scripts.setup: npm exec --yes --package @yarnpkg/cli-dist@4.12.0 -- yarn install --immutable && npm exec --yes --package @yarnpkg/cli-dist@4.12.0 -- yarn --cwd server install --immutable && npm exec --yes --package @yarnpkg/cli-dist@4.12.0 -- yarn --cwd client install --immutable
